# Sketchfab viewer helper

`sketchfab-viewer-1.12.1.js` is the unmodified 6,573-byte official viewer helper downloaded from https://static.sketchfab.com/api/sketchfab-viewer-1.12.1.js on 16 October 2026.

It signals when the site's existing Sketchfab embeds are actually ready. It does not contain or replace any model geometry. API documentation: https://sketchfab.com/developers/viewer .

Author: Sketchfab. Licence: ISC, as declared by the official `@sketchfab/viewer-api` 1.12.1 package metadata at https://registry.npmjs.org/@sketchfab/viewer-api/1.12.1 .
